Name: Hatterene  Fam
Author: DistractedDude
Description:
This mod contains three Pokemon NPCs that give items at different heart levels. Hatterene came to Stardew Valley because she likes people and she changed her old ways of coming to beat ass for miles if someone feels strong emotions. Hatterene came to Stardew Valley with her kids, Hatenna and Spheal. Hatterene has many many many offspring but the only one that changed her ways like Hatterene was Hatenna. Spheal is always trying to protect Hatenna so he could not let her go alone.

IF ANYONE MAKES A VIDEO OF THIS MOD POST IT IN THE COMMENTS, I WANT TO SEE YOUR REACTIONS!

These three have wacky personalities. Hatterene is a touchy feely sweetheart, Hatenna is a little troublemaker and Spheal is a dummy-boi. They do cartoony silly things like for instance Hatenna will casually wipe her face with a stack of hundred dollar bills when talked to(Not animated). Also this mod gets really weird. Hatterene is dateable and once that was a option it got weird from there. So if you ever wanted to date a Pokemon with baggage and become a stepdad this mod is for you. Hatterene is shy and does not talk in a way humans understand until they get to know her but she still tries hard with gestures and drawings to communicate. Hatenna does not give a crap like Hatterene and will invade your mind to mess with you. Spheal is not great at communicating but he bounces around and does actions like collecting rocks for some reason.

They give out items at correct heart levels on Mondays and Wednesdays. Hatenna gives field snacks at two hearts. Spheal gives coffee at four hearts. Hatterene gives life elixir at eight hearts. 

Events have been added for Hatterene. The heart levels of the events I have so far: 1,3,5,8. I have not placed the NPCs at festivals yet but if people would like to suggest coordinates to put them at I will update that too. 

Thanks for checking out my mod!
